faq.label: General
qa: What is SK IT Services?
SK IT Services is a computer shop offering laptop and desktop sales, computer repairs, upgrades, accessories and IT support for individuals and businesses.
Where are you located?
We're located at Lot 1.36, 1st Floor, Plaza Imbi, Jalan Imbi, 55100 Kuala Lumpur.
What are your operating hours?
We're open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and selected public holidays.
Can I walk in without an appointment?
Yes! Walk-ins are welcome during our operating hours. You can also WhatsApp us before visiting to check availability.

faq.label: Repair Services
qa: Do you provide laptop and computer repair services?
Yes. We repair laptops and desktops, including screen and keyboard replacement, battery and charging issues, RAM and SSD upgrades, software problems and component-level motherboard repair.
How long does a typical repair take?
It depends on the fault and on parts availability. We confirm the timing when you drop off your device.
Do you give a quote before starting work?
Yes. We provide a written quote, and no work begins until you approve it.
Can you repair a laptop I bought elsewhere?
Contact us with the model and the problem and we will tell you whether we can help.

faq.label: Products
qa: Do you sell new and used laptops and computer parts?
Yes. We sell new and refurbished laptops, desktops, computer parts and accessories. Every refurbished system is tested before sale.
How do I book a custom PC build?
Fill in the contact form, WhatsApp or call us. We will arrange a short consultation about your usage and budget.
Do you offer delivery or pick-up?
Ask our team about delivery and pick-up options for the product you choose.

faq.label: Business IT
qa: Do you provide IT support for businesses?
Yes. We help with business computer supply, office workstation setup, network and Wi-Fi installation and on-demand technical assistance, subject to assessment.
Do you do home or office visits?
Contact us with your location and we will confirm whether we can visit.

faq.label: Payment & Warranty
qa: Do you offer warranty for repairs?
Ask our team about the warranty on the exact repair or product you choose. We confirm warranty terms in your written quote.
What payment methods do you accept?
Please contact our team to confirm the accepted payment methods before your visit.

faq.label: Others
qa: I have another question. Who do I contact?
WhatsApp us on 011-57579656 or call +60192399656, or email skitsvc@gmail.com. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: How SK IT Services collects, uses and protects your personal data.
sections: Overview

SK IT Services ("we", "us", "our") operates this website and the computer shop at Lot 1.36, First Floor, Imbi Plaza, Jalan Imbi, 55100 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it and the choices you have, in line with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 of Malaysia (PDPA).
By using this website or contacting us, you agree to the practices described here.
Information we collect
We only collect what we need to answer your enquiry and provide our services:

- Contact details: your name, phone number and email address.
- Enquiry details: the device type, brand or model, the issue you describe, the product or service you are asking about and any message you write.
- Service records: details of repairs, purchases, quotations and warranty for work done in our store.
- Technical data: basic browser and device information that your browser sends automatically when you visit the website.
How we collect it
We collect information when you fill in the quote or contact forms on this website, message or call us on WhatsApp or phone, email us, or visit our store.
The forms on this website do not save your details on our servers. When you submit a form, your message is prepared and opened in WhatsApp so that you can send it to us directly.
How we use your information

- To reply to enquiries and prepare quotations.
- To diagnose, repair, set up or supply the product or service you requested.
- To contact you about your job, warranty or after-sales support.
- To keep business records and meet legal, tax and accounting requirements.
- To improve our website and services.
We do not sell your personal data and we do not use it for third-party advertising.
WhatsApp and third-party services

Many buttons on this website open WhatsApp, the phone dialler, your email app or Google Maps. When you use them, your information is handled by those services under their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for how they process data.
Messages you send on WhatsApp are processed by WhatsApp (Meta) and received on our business number.
Cookies
This website does not use advertising cookies. Your browser may store essential technical data needed to display the site. If we add analytics or similar tools in future, we will update this policy.
Sharing your information

We do not share your personal data with others except where it is needed to provide your service (for example, a parts supplier or manufacturer warranty claim), where you ask us to, or where the law or a government authority requires us to.
Your device data

When you leave a device with us for repair, we ask for your approval before work begins. We only access files or accounts on your device where this is necessary to diagnose or complete the repair, and we do not copy or keep your personal files. We recommend that you back up your data before bringing a device in.
Data retention and security

We keep personal data only for as long as needed for the purposes above, including warranty and legal record-keeping, and then delete or anonymise it. We take reasonable steps to protect your information from loss, misuse and unauthorised access, but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.
Your rights

Under the PDPA you may ask to access the personal data we hold about you, request corrections, or withdraw your consent to our use of it. To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before we act on it.
Children
Our services are not directed at children under 18. If you believe a child has given us personal data without a parent or guardian's consent, please contact us so we can remove it.
Changes to this policy
We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page, with the updated date shown at the top.
Contact us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact SK IT Services.
